narration: The Knowledge graph turns scattered manuals and asset data into connected, queryable intelligence.
Nineteen nodes — areas, assets, components, equipment, lines, and sites — linked by verified and proposed relationships.
Solid edges are human-verified. Dashed edges are proposed by MIRA — suggestions you review and confirm, so every answer traces back to grounded knowledge.
Switch to Manuals or the Map, and work through MIRA's suggestions to keep the graph growing.
Knowledge that compounds with every machine.
